audience: teams who collect responses with Fillout forms, such as surveys, contact and signup forms

useCases.title: List your forms and the questions they ask
useCases.text: The AI lists the forms in the account and opens one to read every question with its id, name and type, plus calculations and quiz settings.

useCases.title: Count responses in a date range
useCases.text: The AI counts a form's submissions by date range, status or search text, without pulling the answers. It also counts partial submissions.

useCases.title: Read the latest submissions
useCases.text: The AI lists a form's submissions with the answers, filtered by date range, status or search text, and opens one submission in full.

useCases.title: Export responses of a form and sum them up
useCases.text: The AI fetches many submissions in one call, up to a maximum you set, and summarizes the answers. The result says if the export stopped at that maximum.

useCases.title: Import responses or manage a submission webhook
useCases.text: The AI creates up to 10 submissions on a form from answers you collected elsewhere. It can also add or remove a webhook that receives new submissions.
